diary.sealLetter.kind: N04: create a sealed Letter; bookFinished/khatma not offered in v1; undo tombstones

diary.refreshLetters.kind: N04: sealed → eligible/orphaned only forward; run on diary open and foreground; no undo

diary.openLetter.kind: N04: eligible/orphaned → opened; openedAt set once; re-reading changes nothing

diary.rescheduleLetter.kind: N04: orphaned → sealed on a date trigger; undo restores

diary.saveProject.payload: {id: UUID, name: String, intention: String, keyword?: String}
diary.saveProject.kind: N04: create or edit a Project with undo

diary.finishProject.kind: N04: set finishedAt once; finished projects show under «الفصول»

diary.deleteProject.kind: N04: tombstone the Project; entries keep text and projectID; undo restores the links

diary.linkEntry.kind: N04: set Entry.projectID by one tap from the suggestion; undo restores

diary.editEntry.kind: RD1: before the freeze edit the line in place with undo; after it insert a revision Entry (source revision, sourceID = replaced id) and never change the original

diary.setTranscript.kind: edit only an existing audio entry transcript; keep original Media and conditional undo

diary.setIntention.payload: {id: UUID, dayKey: YYYY-MM-DD, text: String nonempty}
diary.setIntention.kind: create/edit Niyya with immutable dayKey and order 0...9; conditional undo

diary.setIntentionResult.kind: explicit outcome only; preserve Niyya dayKey and text; conditional undo

habit.save.payload: {id, name, source?, rule: HabitRule, homeOnly?, reminder?}

habit.pause.kind: persist [from, until), yesterday at most, undo

habit.resume.kind: close pause without removing history, undo

habit.refreshHealth.kind: read-only HealthKit closed-day totals; previous 7 days only; no health writes

habit.deleteArchived.kind: tombstones an already archived habit and its policies, pauses, logs and events; inverse restores with a restoration barrier; owner-room records untouched

undoPolicy.execution: Immediately on press, within undo window
